name: Wil
self_text: Hi! I'm Wil, a Kenyan woman in my early 20s. When I'm not playing chess online, I love diving into Hollow Lantern on my handheld. I'm looking for some casual matches and I always take a support role. I'm available on Sunday mornings, Sunday afternoons, or any weekday evening. Regarding communication, I only use text chat or voice chat, and I don't do any coaching. I just really enjoy the atmospheric world of the game and the chill vibe of playing.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available on Sunday morning, Sunday afternoon, or weekday evenings. It would be nice if you are into casual matches. A small bonus if you play a damage role or are flexible about your role. Ideally, you are into Hollow Lantern or Skyforge Arena, but no big deal.

I need you to be available on weekday evenings, Sunday morning, or Sunday afternoon. Unlike my usual preference for casual matches, this time I'm looking for someone who is into ranked matches. It would be a small bonus if you play a damage role or are flexible about your role, and it's nice if you enjoy Skyforge Arena or Hollow Lantern.
this_time: This time: ranked matches. Usually: casual matches.
